steps.en: Install the CLI and fetch its matching Chromium once
steps.zh: 装好 CLI，再拉一次配套的 Chromium

steps.en: Point it at a site and pick an export format
steps.zh: 给它一个网址，选一种导出格式

steps.en: Renders the page and reads computed styles off elements that actually paint
steps.zh: 渲染页面，只从真正画出来的元素上读计算样式

steps.en: Clusters colours, type, spacing and radii, elects a primary, writes tokens
steps.zh: 把颜色、字体、间距、圆角聚类，选出主色，写成 token

steps.en: Commit one run as the baseline
steps.zh: 把一次运行结果提交成基线

steps.en: Add the drift-gate step against the preview deployment
steps.zh: 在预览部署上加一步漂移门禁

steps.en: Re-extracts, scores per-token drift, exits 1 and annotates the PR
steps.zh: 重新提取，逐 token 打漂移分，超阈值退出码 1 并在 PR 上标注

value.en: No more copying hex codes out of devtools, and a moved brand colour fails the PR instead of reaching production
value.zh: 不用再从开发者工具里抄色值；主色被改了，PR 直接红，而不是上线后才发现

sources: README.md: Install (npm install -g dembrandt, dembrandt install-browser), Flags (--dtcg), Catch design drift in CI (uses: dembrandt/dembrandt@v0.38.0)
docs/ci.md: Drift gate (dembrandt https://app.example.com --json-only > baseline.json, --compare baseline.json), GitHub Action inputs
CHANGELOG.md 0.36.0: colours read only off elements that paint text or draw a border; 0.35.0: palette and semantic scored apart
action.yml: Dembrandt Drift Gate inputs url/baseline/key/args, outputs report/score
